explanation: The value is nonzero only at D1, and only when the previous trial was an a1 choice that commonly reached S1 right after a trial that did not reach S1 commonly (a rare S2 or an a2 trial). In that case it is about 10 late in the episode (trial 80 and later), about 6-8 around trials 55-79 and about 0-1 earlier, it falls to roughly 7, 3, 1, then 0 over further back-to-back a1-to-S1 common trials, and it is 0 at GO, at D2, after any rare transition and after any a2 trial, whatever the reward.
